title: Giving transmission a fair new beginning

captions.physics: Agreeing on accessible conditions for participation
captions.energy: Preserving foundations of a chosen teaching
captions.emotions: Joy in a new open experience

meaning: Continuing a chosen teaching can inspire you when fair shared actions preserve the pleasure of an open new experience.
text: Preserved knowledge can become a new beginning for someone unfamiliar. The Hierophant in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to continue a chosen teaching and care for its substance. Justice in the physical position describes shared actions: relating contributions to capacities, making understandable agreements and considering consequences. The Fool in emotions brings fresh pleasure in open experience. It feels rewarding that transmission is genuinely accessible without a ready role. Shared meaning can continue through another person’s independent attempt without requiring prior proof of belonging or the confident appearance of knowing the whole further path.

For example, you help an open gathering about old board games become accessible to beginners together. You clearly explain what people can try freely, which objects are shared and where permanent participation need not be chosen immediately. **Fair conditions give living transmission a freely met new beginning.** Someone’s unexpected move brings a smile. Fresh pleasure concerns experience coming alive among new people through your work, continuing through their own evenings and questions beyond an exact reproduction of a familiar circle.

A beginning can narrow if conditions assign people ready roles too early. After one awkward attempt, someone is left with only one permitted type of task. The wish to transmit and the pleasure of open experience remain supportive. Action benefits from distinguishing fair foundations from a final conclusion, retaining responsibility while leaving actual opportunities to try differently and discover a place through independent experience.
